briefdescription.para: Windows dbgeng COM callback implementations and the exception-code table.

detaileddescription.para: Implements the IDebugEventCallbacks, IDebugOutputCallbacks, and IDebugOutputCallbacks2 methods declared in Callbacks.h, the exception handlers that EventCallbacks::Exception dispatches to, and getExceptionName. dbgeng invokes the callbacks during WaitForEvent on the engine context. They fire events on Session::events. None writes to stdout.
